description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Context, which manages a context for the HTML Purifier library. It provides methods to register, retrieve, destroy, check existence, and load variables into the context, stored in an internal array with reference handling.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Context
classes.description: A registry object that manages context-specific data for the HTML Purifier library, allowing registration, access, and management of variables within the context.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a variable in the context by its name, storing a reference to the variable.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to a variable by name; can ignore errors if specified.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes a variable from the context by name.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a variable exists in the context.

methods.name: loadArray
methods.description: Loads multiple variables into the context from an associative array.
